item1.description: Participation in the development of a central IT system for judicial administration in the public sector. Focus on the further development of the core architecture and the implementation of backend components using Java and Spring Boot. Development of Microservices. Collaboration in an agile environment with business and development teams as part of a nationwide digitalization project.

item2.company: Alfred Kärcher SE & Co. KG (Winnenden, Germany)
item2.description: Conception and evaluation of a customized API management strategy in Domain Driven Design. Analyzing the API landscape. Conducting Expert Interviews to identify current challenges in the development of APIs. Defining API standards and guidelines. Comparison of different API management tools.

item3.description: Software Engineer in the Research & Development (R&D) department for TruConnect, a solution for the manufacturing industry that enables smart factory operations. Programming tools with .NET Framework for internal use. Support the development of an application (SmartView) for monitoring that provides detailed insight such as performance data and energy consumption in lasers and laser systems. Implementation of a 3D View of the machines using Angular and .NET.

item4.description: Support the team in the frontend development of HATS UI using Vue.js. HATS (Highly Autonomous Teleoperation Service) is a service that allows you to control robots remotely. It is a system targeting remote operation in the task execution of autonomous robots. HATS UI is a web application that provides various functions for the communication with robots. Server-side development with Ruby on Rails. Creating API documentation and Unit tests.

item5.description: Part of the Digital Customer Experience. Worked for a Customer Messaging System (CusMeS). Fullstack Development in an agile team (Scrum). Support in the development of a web application for an international automotive manufacturer (OEM) with Angular and Java Spring which enables mass messaging through different channels such as SMS, WhatsApp, E-Mails. item6.description: Software development in an agile and international development team. Development of tools in C# and .NET Framework. Development and extension of a web application in the intralogistics environment for transportation and stock management using Angular, HTML5 and CSS. Creation of REST APIs with ASP.NET. Preparation, configuration, implementation and evaluation of a comparison between the dynamic tour planning algorithm and the static tour planning algorithm for intralogistics tugger trains.

item7.description: Worked in the field of software development. Creation of standard software and website programming with HTML/CSS and JavaScript. Support in website optimization (SEO) with CMS (WordPress). Database development with PostgreSQL.

Privacy.intro: These notices explain how personal data is processed when you visit sonhaivu.com or contact us. Personal data is information relating to an identified or identifiable person.

hosting.title: Hosting and access logs: Vercel
hosting.body: The website and server-side contact form processing run on Vercel Inc., 440 N Barranca Avenue #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA. Vercel processes technically necessary connection data on page visits: particularly your IP address, timestamp, requested URL, browser and device information, and any referrer URL transmitted. Form submissions also pass through this infrastructure.
hosting.details: The purposes are website delivery, troubleshooting and protection against abuse and attacks. The legal basis for technical operation is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is a secure and reliable website. Retention of technical logs depends on the Vercel services used, their settings and the need for security analysis. Processing exclusively within Europe is not guaranteed.

contact.title: Contact form and direct email
contact.body: The form requires your first name, last name, email address and message. A phone number is optional. These details are used to handle your request and follow up with you. The form cannot be submitted without required details. You can instead write directly to info@sonhaivu.com without consenting to reCAPTCHA; we then process your sender address, message and any other information you provide.
contact.details: Article 6(1)(b) GDPR applies to contractual and pre-contractual requests. Other requests are answered under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is communicating with interested parties and handling their concerns. Consent to reCAPTCHA is separate and is not the legal basis for processing the content of your request. Please do not send unnecessary sensitive data.

email.title: Email delivery: Resend; mailbox: Purelymail
email.body: After successful CAPTCHA verification, the website sends your request through Resend (Plus Five Five, Inc., 2261 Market Street #5039, San Francisco, CA 94114, USA) to info@sonhaivu.com. Data includes the names entered, your email as the reply address, the optional phone number and the message. Resend also processes delivery and transmission metadata. The website does not create its own contact database; this does not mean that email providers do not store the message.
email.details: The receiving mailbox is operated by Purelymail (Add Rabbit LLC, USA). It processes messages, addresses and email metadata for receipt, storage and replies, including direct emails. Purelymail identifies AWS US-East-1 in Virginia, USA, as its server location. The legal bases are set out in the contact section. Both providers may use subprocessors necessary to provide their services.

captcha.title: Spam protection with Google reCAPTCHA
captcha.body: The contact form uses Google reCAPTCHA v2. Google code loads only after you consent. Your IP address, browser and device information, page context, interaction data and verification data may be transmitted to Google and assessed to detect automated or abusive requests. Google uses the _GRECAPTCHA cookie for risk analysis. Because the integration uses google.com, existing Google cookies may also be involved. Processing in the USA is possible.
captcha.details: According to its current reCAPTCHA documentation, Google has processed Customer Data as a processor under Google Cloud terms since April 2, 2026, for security, fraud prevention and abuse prevention. Our integration relies on your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and, for information stored on or accessed from your device, Section 25(1) TDDDG. The server sends the generated verification token to Google, not your message text. Without consent, form submission stays disabled; direct email remains available.

cookies.title: First-party cookies and language preference
cookies.body: userCookieConsent stores your acceptance or refusal of reCAPTCHA as true or false for 365 days. NEXT_LOCALE stores your chosen language (de, en or ja) for 365 days. Both cookies apply across the website; a new selection can restart their lifetime. They do not contain names or messages and are not used for advertising.
cookies.details: Storing your privacy choice and requested language preference is based on Section 25(2)(2) TDDDG. Related personal data processing relies on Article 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is respecting your choices and providing the requested language. Google determines the lifetimes of cookies used by reCAPTCHA; further cookie information is linked below. You can delete cookies in your browser settings at any time.

withdrawal.title: Changing or withdrawing consent
withdrawal.body: The privacy settings on this page and in the footer let you reopen the choice and withdraw earlier consent by selecting Decline. On withdrawal, the page reloads so that reCAPTCHA code already loaded in this document does not keep running. reCAPTCHA is then not loaded again unless you consent again.
withdrawal.details: Withdrawal takes effect for the future and does not affect the lawfulness of earlier processing (Article 7(3) GDPR). It does not recall data already sent. This website cannot itself delete Google cookies on other domains; use your browser or Google settings. Your current choice is saved in the consent cookie.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body: There is no fixed blanket deletion period for contact requests. Relevant criteria are handling and any follow-up of the request, ongoing contractual relationships, statutory retention duties and the need to establish or defend legal claims. Data must be deleted when its purpose ends and no further legal basis applies. Legally required retention is based on Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
retention.details: These criteria also apply to messages in the mailbox and at delivery providers; the form code does not perform automatic scheduled deletion. Provider logs and backups are additionally subject to service settings and provider retention periods. Purelymail states that diagnostic logs are deleted after 30 days and account data can remain in backups for up to 30 days after account closure. This is not a 30-day deletion period for individual contact requests. First-party cookie lifetimes are listed in the cookie section.

transfers.title: Recipients and international transfers
transfers.body: Recipients are the hosting, email and security providers described above and their necessary subprocessors. Vercel, Resend, Purelymail and Google may process data outside the EEA, particularly in the USA, where privacy rules and public authority access may differ. Consent to reCAPTCHA does not replace the separately required safeguards for international transfers under Articles 44 et seq. GDPR.
transfers.details: Possible bases include an applicable adequacy decision under Article 45 GDPR or appropriate safeguards such as EU Standard Contractual Clauses under Article 46 GDPR. Vercel and Resend describe the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses in their linked documents; applicability depends on the recipient and contract. This does not constitute a corresponding assurance for Purelymail. You can request information about safeguards applicable to your data and, where relevant, copies at the contact address above.

assets.title: Fonts, external links and security
assets.body: Fonts are served with the website; your browser does not connect to Google Fonts to display them. No separate analytics or advertising tracking scripts are embedded in the website; the hosting and security processing described above is unaffected. Social network and project links are ordinary external links, not embedded social media feeds. The destination privacy notice applies when you visit it.
assets.details: The website and form use HTTPS. Complete security of every email transmission cannot be guaranteed. Automated reCAPTCHA checks may prevent form submission but do not constitute a decision with legal or similarly significant effects within Article 22 GDPR. Contact by email remains available.

rights.title: Your rights and complaints
rights.body: Subject to statutory conditions, you have rights of access (Article 15 GDPR), rectification (Article 16), erasure (Article 17), restriction of processing (Article 18) and data portability (Article 20). You may withdraw consent at any time with effect for the future. To exercise your rights, write to the contact address above; suitable proof of identity may be requested where necessary.
rights.details: Under Article 77 GDPR, you may complain to a data protection supervisory authority, particularly where you habitually reside or work, or where the alleged infringement occurred. The authority for the stated location is the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information Baden-Württemberg. Its complaints page is linked below.

objection.title: Objecting to legitimate-interest processing
objection.body: Where data is processed under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, you may object under Article 21(1) on grounds relating to your particular situation. Processing must then stop unless compelling legitimate grounds overriding your interests, rights and freedoms are demonstrated, or processing serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
objection.details: You may object to processing for direct marketing at any time without giving reasons (Article 21(2) GDPR). Send your objection to the email address above.
